subject: Post-call recap: cost-sensitivity heatmap & buying window
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Nguyen <ava@orchardhealth.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: cost-sensitivity heatmap & buying window

Hi Ava — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the asks we captured on the call so we can align procurement and finance internally. Please confirm anything I’ve missed.

Call summary:
- Use case: patient intake summarization + clinical note augmentation (structured output + redaction).
- Expected peak concurrency: small (2–5 active sessions) but high burst token rates for batch backfills.
- Sequence lengths: typical 1–2k tokens; worst-case 6k.

Pricing & volume assumptions we discussed (please confirm):
- Baseline consumption: ~150M tokens / month (extracting & summarization).
- Upside scenario: 350–500M tokens / month within 6 months if rollout to pilot clinics succeeds.
- Current target unit economics you prioritized: target $/1M tokens = $55 (we discussed $40–$70 bands).
- Preferred monthly spend band (procurement view): $8k — $42k / month

Procurement thresholds you mentioned on the call:
- PO required for any commitment > $20k / month or annualized > $240k.
- Standard vendor onboarding (security attestation + SOC 2) is a blocker; your procurement expects evidence by signing.

Attached: RW_cost-heatmap_v1.xlsx — heatmap showing monthly spend across token volumes & pricing tiers, plus a one-page Scope_and_MOPs.pdf that outlines what we would log and retain for audits.

Next steps (owner):
- Ava: confirm the baseline and upside token ranges and whether the PO threshold of $20k/month is firm or negotiable (reply here).
- Soojin: prepare a 90–day pilot offer with a capped escalation, and a mutual action plan (MAP) for procurement.
- Rishi/Marissa: review the heatmap and propose a committed-discount ladder we can table.

If you prefer, we can lock a short 90-day pilot at a conservative $/1M token rate to let you validate throughput without long-term commitment.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: RW_cost-heatmap_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Scope_and_MOPs.pdf (PDF)

From: Ava Nguyen <ava@orchardhealth.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Orchard Procurement <procurement@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: cost-sensitivity heatmap & buying window

Thanks, Soojin — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Baseline looks right — the 150M/month is what the intake team estimated for our initial 6 clinics.
- Upside: 300–400M/month is more realistic in our timeline (we were conservative on the call).
- Target $/1M: $50 is our internal comfort point; $55 is acceptable if we get stronger commit discounts above 300M/month.

Procurement specifics: 
- PO threshold: we require a PO for any invoice > $25k; for pilot spending below that we'll use credit card or short-term approvals.
- SOC 2 + data processing addendum: procurement needs SOC 2 Type II report and DPA executed before production.
- Standard payment terms: Net 30. If we commit to 6–12 months we can push to Net 45 with a standing PO.

Quick Qs: 
1) Is the $50/$55 band inclusive of inference compute + platform fees or is there a separate infra surcharge?
2) For the heatmap, can you show a 30/60/90-day buying window projection so we can present to finance?

Appreciate the 90-day pilot offer — please include an explicit clause for data isolation and export at termination.

— Ava
Ava Nguyen
Head of Platform Integrations | Orchard Health
ava@orchardhealth.ai | (617) 555-0134

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ava Nguyen <ava@orchardhealth.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Sep 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: cost-sensitivity heatmap & buying window

Looping in a few pricing clarifications from our side so external teams have quick answers. Ava — copying the answers into the thread so procurement has it in one place.

1) Rate composition: the $/1M token figure we've been discussing is the all-in platform price (model + runtime + platform). There is no separate surcharge for infra unless you require dedicated capacity (Dedicated pools). Dedicated pricing would be quoted separately and typically applies for sustained >500M/month needs or strict isolation.

2) Commit discounts: model we propose (draft):
- <200M/month: listed rate (no commit)
- 200–350M/month: 10% off listed $/1M
- 350–600M/month: 18% off listed $/1M
(we can tune these bands once you confirm expected uplift cadence)

3) Buying window / pilot structure: we can do a 90-day pilot with a capped spend (you pick cap) and convert any overage into the commit ramp if you choose to sign a short MSA within 30 days of pilot end.

Attached a quick pricing-calculation-8532.csv with sample monthly rows at $50 and $55/1M and the effective monthly invoice for baseline vs upside.

Soojin — can you prepare the 30/60/90-day buy-window slides from the heatmap and include the wording for PO threshold and DPA?

Thanks,
Rishi
Director, Pricing & GTM Economics | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2028 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: cost-sensitivity heatmap & buying window

Hi Ava / team — thanks for the quick confirmation. Per Rishi's notes, I’ve attached an updated heatmap with a 30/60/90-day buying window and a sample pricing ladder that reflects the commit discounts discussed. See attached RW_cost-heatmap_v1.xlsx (sheet: 30-60-90) and pricing-calculation-8532.csv.

Two explicit items for procurement: 
- PO threshold: we will accept a pilot under $25k on credit card. For any recurring billing > $25k/month we require a PO + MSA. If you want a temporary standing PO we can accept PO issuance for the pilot with a capped invoice schedule.
- Compliance: we will provide our SOC 2 Type II report and a standard DPA. I'll send both to procurement once you indicate a preferred signing contact.

Proposed MAP (timeline):
- Week 0: sign DPA + limited pilot MSA (execution target 1 week)
- Week 1–12: 90-day pilot (ceil at your chosen cap; recommended cap $30k)
- Week 8: checkpoint to decide on commit band (if uptick >200M/month, discuss 200–350M band)
- Week 12: convert to 6-month ramped commit or terminate and export data

If that looks good I’ll open a procurement thread (DocuSign + HubSpot deal update) and share the SOC 2 link.

One more ask to finance: would you prefer invoices monthly or net-30 consolidated quarterly for the pilot? (Ava — you had said Net 30 is standard.)

Best,
Soojin
Senior Solutions Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai

Attachments: RW_cost-heatmap_v1.xlsx (sheet: 30-60-90), pricing-calculation-8532.csv, Scope_and_MOPs.pdf
